description: Log in once by running steps on a login page, then save the browser's cookies and storage to .qa-mcp/auth/<name>.json. Pass that file as session.storage_state to other tools, or to Playwright's storageState in tests. Put passwords in environment variables and reference them as ${ENV:NAME}; never pass them literally. The saved file contains session tokens: keep .qa-mcp/auth out of version control.

device.description: Emulate a device for mobile web: a Playwright device name such as "iPhone 15" or "Pixel 7" (list_devices), or "desktop" (default)

url.description: For goto; may be relative to the start URL

value.description: For fill/press/select. Use ${ENV:NAME} for secrets such as passwords.

success_locator.description: Locator that must be visible after login, e.g. page.getByRole('heading', { name: 'My account' })

name: save_login_state
title: Save login state
